name: test_save_and_descriptor_hash_replay
assertion_scope: 保存并重放descriptor的真实普通blob SHA/远端提交。

name: test_repeat_has_no_empty_commit
assertion_scope: 重复保存无空commit。

name: test_scope_preserves_unrelated_dirty_file
assertion_scope: scope外未暂存脏文件保留且不入提交。

name: test_unrelated_staged_file_is_not_committed
assertion_scope: scope外已暂存文件阻止本次commit且index保留。

name: test_explicit_paths_include_root_file_and_spaces
assertion_scope: 显式paths包括根文件/含空格中文路径。

name: test_deleted_file_committed_without_blob_descriptor
assertion_scope: 删除被提交但无blob descriptor。

name: test_network_failure_retry_saves_once
assertion_scope: fetch/push注入离线保本地snapshot，同命令重试只保存一次。

name: test_lost_push_response_is_confirmed
assertion_scope: 真实本地push后注入丢响应仍可fetch确认。

name: test_remote_disjoint_changes_merge_automatically
assertion_scope: 远端不交变更自动merge并保双方。

name: test_remote_real_conflict_aborts_preserves_local_snapshot
assertion_scope: 同文件真冲突abort保本地snapshot/正文。

name: test_dirty_other_work_blocks_divergence_without_loss
assertion_scope: 其他tracked工作脏时分叉停止且内容不丢。

name: test_live_writer_lock_blocks_second_checkpoint
assertion_scope: 同common-dir活跃writer锁拒绝第二写者。

name: test_detached_head_and_board_branch_rejected
assertion_scope: detached及公屏分支拒绝。

name: test_paths_and_credentials_rejected_before_commit
assertion_scope: 凭据样式正文/commit message、越界/缺路径在提交前拒绝。

name: test_staged_secret_reverted_to_head_does_not_leak
assertion_scope: 暂存合成secret又把工作树改回HEAD，scope add覆盖旧index而不泄漏。

name: test_external_auth_remembers_path_only
assertion_scope: 外部合成token只记路径、不进config或JSON回执内容。

name: test_inherited_git_routing_cannot_touch_another_index
assertion_scope: 继承Git路由不能写诱饵index。

name: test_remote_moves_between_local_commit_and_push
assertion_scope: 本地commit与push间peer移动仍能merge两方。

name: test_missing_identity_works_for_commit_and_auto_merge
assertion_scope: 缺Git署名时临时署名支持commit与merge。

name: test_complete_launcher_runs_outside_checkout
assertion_scope: checkpoint.sh可从clone外按--repo执行完整CLI。

name: test_invalid_or_in_repo_token_file_refused
assertion_scope: 无效/仓库内token文件拒绝。

name: test_conflicting_push_destination_refused
assertion_scope: origin fetch/push目的地不同则提交前拒绝。

name: test_preexisting_out_of_scope_commit_cannot_hitchhike_on_checkpoint
assertion_scope: 此前scope外commit不能搭本次scope push便车。

name: test_explicit_backlog_scope_has_complete_receipt_and_descriptors
assertion_scope: 显式覆盖backlog范围时receipt/outgoing/descriptors含全部相关提交/文件。

name: test_historical_secret_overwritten_by_safe_text_is_not_pushed
assertion_scope: 历史secret被安全文字覆盖仍阻止push。

name: test_historical_secret_deleted_before_checkpoint_is_not_pushed
assertion_scope: 历史secret后来删除仍阻止push。

name: test_historical_credential_filename_and_commit_metadata_are_rejected
assertion_scope: 历史凭据文件名和原始commit元数据即使后来删除仍拒绝。

name: test_historical_symlink_removed_before_checkpoint_is_rejected
assertion_scope: 历史symlink后来删除仍拒绝。

name: test_peer_changes_outside_scope_do_not_block_disjoint_merge
assertion_scope: 已公开peer的scope外不交变更不阻止merge，不误记本方outgoing。

name: test_historical_secret_in_merge_resolution_is_not_pushed
assertion_scope: 合并resolution历史secret拒绝，原left祖先保留。

name: test_default_scope_includes_own_workspace_and_leaves_peer_draft
assertion_scope: 默认scope只含本人workspace，不取peer草稿。

name: test_unrelated_archive_defaults_select_its_topic_and_common_registers_only
assertion_scope: UM存档取本主题/公共登记表/本人workspace，排除旧WC及相似前缀。

name: test_unbound_checkpoint_uses_current_topic_and_only_own_current_workspace
assertion_scope: 无绑定时默认当前CAG与本人当前workspace，排除旧WC/shared/peer。

name: test_cag_scope_includes_flat_audits_deleted_audits_and_paper_assets_only
assertion_scope: CAG平铺audits/已跟踪删除audits/paper资产正确入scope，排除相似目录和peer。

name: test_unbound_checkpoint_with_only_legacy_paths_requires_explicit_scope
assertion_scope: 无绑定但仅有旧scope时不回退WC，要求显式范围。

name: test_unrelated_archive_precommitted_old_topic_cannot_hitchhike
assertion_scope: UM绑定下预提交旧WC不能搭便车。

name: test_unknown_archive_defaults_include_only_common_registers_and_own_workspace
assertion_scope: 未知存档只公共登记表和本人workspace，不猜未注册数学目录。

name: test_archive_with_no_effective_default_paths_requires_explicit_scope
assertion_scope: 未知存档无有效默认项拒绝；显式paths可保存。

name: test_explicit_shared_archive_preserves_legacy_topic_defaults
assertion_scope: 显式shared保旧主题默认值。

name: test_deleted_unrelated_archive_asset_remains_in_default_scope
assertion_scope: 已跟踪删除UM资产仍保在默认scope。

name: test_default_workspace_save_and_explicit_scope_for_peer
assertion_scope: 默认本人workspace与显式处理peer范围的区别。

name: test_precommitted_peer_workspace_is_not_in_default_scope
assertion_scope: 预提交peer workspace不在默认scope，阻止push。

name: test_workspace_ids_cannot_escape_default_scope
assertion_scope: actor含../不能逃默认目录。

name: test_invalid_archive_without_actor_is_rejected
assertion_scope: 无actor时坏save也被拒绝。

name: test_unavailable_remote_baseline_never_pushes_unexamined_history
assertion_scope: fresh remote baseline不可得时不尝试push，保本地commit。
